profiles.floor03: candidate + reject if 2.5*atr/close*100 < 0.3 (both sides), veto first

account.mode: one continuous book per profile from window start, no reset; fixed 0.01; 10% cost-inclusive cap; daily10%/2 losses; cooldown2

window.end_rule: window_end(last_quote_utc): exclusive end at last complete UTC day
window.finalize: True: open position at end liquidated END_OF_SAMPLE, reported separately

frame: single frame from input/bars.csv starting 2026-08-02 22:15 UTC (Aug-Oct old forward zips + new monthly zips); EMA200 frame-start dependence disclosed

maturity.rule: verdict only when (end-start)>=28d AND native trades in vm490|base >=20; earlier runs are INTERIM, no verdict

verdict.per_profile_vs_native: NOT_EXERCISED if ledger identical to native in vm490|base and vm490|stress; else FORWARD_CONSISTENT iff in both: net>=native AND maxDD<=native; else FORWARD_INCONSISTENT. arch567 reported, not decisive.
verdict.floor_vs_candidate: same rule floor03 vs candidate, reported separately

causality: each run, vm490 base+stress: native/candidate/floor03 prefix runs at Wed 12:00 and Sat 00:00 cutoffs (finalize=False, ticks truncated, indicators re-prepared from bars before cutoff) must reproduce full-run admission events before cutoff; any mismatch or zero cutoffs -> INVALID
input_integrity: build(): manifest removed first; previous build must be byte prefix of new build; run(): every input artifact re-hashed vs manifest; engine module set = transitive closure pinned; reports never overwritten (name includes manifest sha)
prior_peek: native/B2/AB were run on 2026-10-24..11-11 earlier (seen). v1 protocol 173c07a8 produced one INTERIM report on 2026-10-24..11-17 where all three profiles had identical ledgers (8 SELL trades, risk<$25, floor not binding); review then found integrity defects and the vacuous-equality verdict, fixed in v2 before any verdict. Profiles, account, views, maturity and comparison thresholds unchanged from v1.
owner_constraints: real money PROHIBITED; no VM change; criteria fixed, no post-hoc change; no reselection on forward data
